periods.time: After Stella's match, before D-block and compressed schedule
periods.label: 厄运的真实恩宠
periods.affiliation: Akatsuki Academy; formerly Kyomon Academy; Rebellion side

status.current: D-block contestant advancing after Kiriko forfeits; identified as wish/luck causality manipulator
status.threat_level: extreme because his wishes reliably become reality through uncontrolled chains of events

personality.summary: Outwardly sweet and fanlike toward Ikki, but his affection hides a deep desire to watch Ikki struggle, bleed and break against fate.
fears: being rejected by Ikki, though he masks it quickly
values: not doing what Ikki explicitly hates

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Claims to be Ikki's fan and offers him the championship, but Ikki rejects him after seeing he wants Ikki to suffer beautifully.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Shizuku openly despises him, blocks him from clinging to Ikki, and intends to defeat him in D-block.
relationships.kiriko-yakushi: Forces her withdrawal indirectly when all patients at her hospital suddenly become critical after he wishes not to fight her.
relationships.utakata-misogi: Previously defeated him at Hagun; Utakata wakes and warns that Amane's power is not prediction but something worse.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: His reveal contextualizes why he had seen Alice's betrayal plan in volume 05.

periods.summary: Amane appears cheerfully before Ikki after Stella's match, but his claim that he will not fight Kiriko is proven when every inpatient at Kiriko's hospital suddenly becomes critical, forcing her to leave. Ikki deduces from this and Utakata's loss that Amane is not a future seer; instead, events reorder themselves to fulfill Amane's wishes. Amane confirms his Device ability, Excessive Goddess's Favor, has never failed, though he claims he only wishes and does not control the method. He offers to make Ikki the Seven Stars champion as an apology, but Ikki rejects the offer as an attack on the meaning of his effort and promise. Amane then reveals the dark core beneath his admiration: he wants to watch Ikki resist fate, suffer, bleed and collapse. The next day Ikki and Shizuku suspect Amane's power may also be behind the schedule compression that worsens Ikki's path.

key_events.summary: Kiriko leaves the tournament when Amane's wish causes hospital-wide crisis.
Ikki exposes Amane's real wish-granting luck power and refuses his championship gift.
Ikki and Shizuku suspect Amane's wish contributed to the forced double-match day.
